source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I've been sorting through what I want to do with the beginning (first 3 chapters). I like Envoy as the opening, but you're right - his presence in this book is not as the rogue AI. I wanted to introduce him in this book but right now, the beginning doesn't tie in completely.

What if:
Keep it but move it to the end, as sort of an epilogue. Change a few things, so it seems like Sage didn't really shut him down. He was pretending and reboots at the end and it ends with I am God...
What are your thoughts? I have mixed feelings. Is it a lose end, even as epilogue? I also like the way the book currently ends, I think its effective (editing needed). So I'm not sure if that will work. I would love to use the chapter, but not sure how if not at the end.

Regarding chapter 2 (Beginnings):
A) I would delete a big chunk. Change it to 3rd person, so it appears as if someone is telling a story. Then transition to Chapter 3 Mortal Life in some way, to make it clear that the story has now shifted to Sage's perspective. I don't know the most effective to do this or if it makes sense. I would also cut out the first two paragraphs in Mortal LIfe.

B) Delete Beginnings entirely.

Chapter 3 (Mortal Life)
Take the first 2 paragraphs and use it as a prologue (I know how people feel about prologues - mixed opinions), then start the chapter as mentioned above.

I hope this isn't too confusing. I see several options and do really want to keep Mortal Life intact, minus the first 2 paragraphs, delete all of most of Beginnings and possibly change to 3rd person, and move Envoy to the end or sacrifice him :)

I've also been thinking about Sage's childhood voice. I do think it almost sounds like a YA novel. I like the idea of having the voice be who she is in that moment, so we experience the world from her eyes. But need further guidance on this. I do recognize the issues with shifting from story mode (future Sage) to present day Sage and have reworked a lot in the book, except those earlier chapters that I mentioned above.

Happy to hear your thoughts tomorrow!

Some other things we can talk about tomorrow also.

Bela

value_updates.decision_needed: Determine whether to delete Beginnings entirely or retain a substantially shortened and revised version.
retained_version_changes: change the chapter to third person so it appears that someone is telling a story
value_updates.transition_goal: Transition into Mortal Life in a way that makes clear the story has shifted to Sage's perspective.
